grammar.label: countable and uncountable — full set and containers
grammar.form: a piece of, a bottle of, a slice of, a bit of, a cup of

explanation.en: To count an uncountable noun, use a container or unit word: 'two pieces of advice'.
explanation.uz: Sanalmaydigan otni sanash uchun idish yoki o'lchov so'zi ishlatiladi: 'two pieces of advice'.

grammar.positive_example: Can I have two pieces of bread?

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek tilida bu otlar sanaladi, ingliz tilida esa yo'q.

grammar.label: so / such (a) + adjective
grammar.form: so + adjective; such a + adjective + noun

explanation.en: 'so' comes before an adjective alone; 'such a' before an adjective plus a noun.
explanation.uz: 'so' — yolg'iz sifat oldidan; 'such a' — sifat + ot oldidan.

grammar.positive_example: It was such a good film.
grammar.negative_example: It was so a good film.

l1_notes.uz: Ot bor bo'lsa — 'such a'; ot yo'q bo'lsa — 'so'.

grammar.label: linkers — however, also, then, finally, for example
grammar.meaning: joins and organises ideas across sentences

explanation.en: These join whole sentences. 'However' starts a new sentence and takes a comma.
explanation.uz: Bular butun gaplarni bog'laydi. 'However' yangi gapni boshlaydi va vergul oladi.

grammar.positive_example: It was cold. However, we went out.
grammar.negative_example: It was cold, however we went out.

l1_notes.uz: 'however' dan keyin vergul; 'but' dan keyin vergul yo'q.

body.text: We have so many guests this evening. Fifty people!

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: That is such a big number. What can I do?

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Bring water and a kilo of rice.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Four of them. Also some cheese, please.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: The table is such a small one. Where do they sit?

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: In the garden. However, the rain is a problem.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Good idea. Finally, do not forget the napkins.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: I buy them today. For example, the shop near the market has them.
